scope: Official product and release pages, including Forever-labelled results on CurseForge and Wago. Filtered catalog enumeration was unavailable, so completeness across all published projects is not certified.

addons.name: TomTom
addons.summary: TomTom supplies coordinate waypoints, map clicks, a floating arrow and corpse guidance.
addons.choice: Choose TomTom for its waypoint workflow and arrow themes; choose Waypoint Tracker for a 3D arrow with built-in Find, Nearest and Real routes.
addons.quest_map: Uses quest POIs; database not stated
addons.both: Yes. When TomTom is installed, Waypoint Tracker leaves /way and the waypoint API to TomTom. Use /wp for Waypoint Tracker; third-party TomTom waypoints then belong to TomTom.
addons.recommendation_basis: Editorial comparison of the documented roles; not a benchmark or client interoperability test.

addons.name: Questie
addons.summary: Questie shows quest starts, objectives and turn-ins on the map, with a quest tracker and searchable database.
addons.choice: Choose Questie for a quest-map overview and journey history; choose Waypoint Tracker for named destinations and a 3D arrow with travel planning.
addons.languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Taiwanese, Korean; Ukrainian via companion
addons.both: Questie documents TomTom objective arrows. Supported TomTom waypoint calls can target Waypoint Tracker when TomTom is absent; with TomTom installed, they target TomTom.
addons.recommendation_basis: Editorial comparison of the documented roles; not a benchmark or client interoperability test.

addons.name: pfQuest
addons.summary: pfQuest combines a quest arrow, objective map nodes and a database browser for NPCs, items, objects and quests on its documented Vanilla/TBC clients.
addons.choice: For a documented Forever 1.60.1 build, choose Waypoint Tracker; pfQuest is a relevant database and quest-helper comparison for its own supported clients.
addons.support: Forever not stated; Vanilla/TBC, WotLK beta documented
addons.nearest: Service tracking lists; nearest not stated
addons.languages: English, Korean, French, German, Chinese, Spanish, Russian
addons.both: The checked pfQuest sources document Vanilla/TBC rather than a Forever build. Check for a compatible Forever release before pairing it with Waypoint Tracker.
addons.recommendation_basis: Editorial comparison of the documented roles; not a benchmark or client interoperability test.

addons.both: Use a Forever-compatible HandyNotes build and plugin for map markers alongside Waypoint Tracker. Plugins with supported TomTom waypoint calls can target its arrow when TomTom is absent.
addons.recommendation_basis: Editorial comparison of the documented roles; not a benchmark or client interoperability test.

nearest: Nearest ships a complete trainer database: over 500 trainers across capitals, starting areas and towns of both factions. It covers all nine classes, all 12 professions (including Cooking, First Aid and Fishing), weapon masters and riding trainers, including Alliance shaman and Horde paladin trainers. Positions favour observations from WoW Forever. Your discoveries add to the shipped database, so you can find trainers before visiting them. Nearest chooses the closest location for your faction; the 3D arrow takes you there by the fastest route. Use /wp, open Find and choose Nearest, or use the minimap button’s right-click Nearest menu.
hub_answer: Choose Waypoint Tracker for a 3D waypoint arrow, Find by name and a complete trainer database on WoW Forever. Choose Questie for a quest-map overview, a leveling guide for a suggested quest sequence, or TomTom for its coordinate-waypoint workflow and arrow themes. TomTom-compatible addons can send supported waypoints to Waypoint Tracker when TomTom is absent.
method: Compared by the Waypoint Tracker project using the official sources below, last checked 2026-11-13; our baseline is 1.4.1. This is a selected catalog snapshot, with no live-client or performance tests. Features vary by client: check for a Forever release. Integration is described only where documented; keep required dependencies.
matrix_legend: — means the checked source does not establish the feature, not that it is absent. Routing may mean quest order, gathering loops, transport markers or a planned journey.
